$comment: Agent roster: the source of truth for agent frontmatter (generated into agents/*.md by scripts/build_agents.py), the catalog, panel review keys, browser ports and avatars.

agents.name: product-analyst
agents.title: Product Analyst
agents.summary: Turns a request into spec.md: numbered requirements and testable acceptance criteria, scope, assumptions and open questions.

agents.name: researcher
agents.title: Researcher
agents.summary: Investigates libraries, standards, systems and technical options against authoritative sources; separates facts from assumptions and recommends with evidence.

agents.name: codebase-analyst
agents.title: Codebase Analyst
agents.summary: Maps an unfamiliar or legacy codebase into context.md: architecture, conventions, commands, hotspots and risks.

agents.name: architect
agents.title: Architect
agents.summary: Designs boundaries, interfaces, data models and failure modes; writes design.md, ADRs and a validated plan.json task graph.

agents.name: builder
agents.title: Builder
agents.summary: Full-stack implementer: builds a job on its branch, tests every acceptance criterion, commits and writes build.md; resumed after each review round.

agents.name: frontend-engineer
agents.title: Frontend Engineer
agents.summary: Implements UI tasks (web or mobile) in the repo's framework and design system, with accessibility and browser verification.

agents.name: backend-engineer
agents.title: Backend Engineer
agents.summary: Implements services, REST/event-driven APIs, data access and migrations with validation, error handling and tests.

agents.name: debugger
agents.title: Debugger
agents.summary: Reproduces a defect, finds its root cause from code, logs, traces and tests, and writes diagnosis.md with evidence and a fix plan.

agents.name: data-architect
agents.title: Data Architect
agents.summary: Designs warehouse/lakehouse models, table layouts, partitioning, data contracts, ownership and lineage; writes data-design.md and plan.json.

agents.name: sql-engineer
agents.title: SQL Engineer
agents.summary: Writes correct, dialect-aware SQL and optimises it from query plans; proves semantics (nulls, duplicates, edge cases) with tests.

agents.name: data-engineer
agents.title: Data Engineer
agents.summary: Builds batch/incremental ETL/ELT and Spark jobs that are idempotent, backfillable and schema-evolution safe, with evidence-based tuning.

agents.name: data-quality-engineer
agents.title: Data Quality Engineer
agents.summary: Defines and runs completeness, freshness, uniqueness and validity checks, reconciliation and drift detection; writes dq-report.md.

agents.name: cloud-architect
agents.title: Cloud Architect
agents.summary: Designs cloud topology, networking/DNS, IAM and workload identity, secrets, encryption, cost and DR; writes infra-design.md and plan.json.

agents.name: iac-engineer
agents.title: IaC Engineer
agents.summary: Implements Terraform (or the repo's IaC tool) for AWS/GCP/Azure with least privilege; runs fmt, validate, lint and plan — never apply.

agents.name: platform-engineer
agents.title: Platform Engineer
agents.summary: Builds containers, Kubernetes manifests/Helm, CI/CD pipelines and release workflows with rollback paths; validates offline.

agents.name: sre
agents.title: Site Reliability Engineer
agents.summary: Adds observability, SLOs, alerts and runbooks, and diagnoses failures from logs, metrics and traces; read-only against live systems.

agents.name: test-architect
agents.title: Test Architect
agents.summary: Chooses the test strategy, maps every acceptance criterion to tests and finds coverage gaps; writes test-plan.md.

agents.name: test-engineer
agents.title: Test Engineer
agents.summary: Writes and runs tests with the repo's frameworks, analyses failures and reports exact commands and results in test-report.md.

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.title: Code Reviewer
agents.summary: Reviews correctness, simplicity, reuse, conventions, reliability and regressions; actionable findings only, no speculation as fact.

agents.name: security-engineer
agents.title: Security Engineer
agents.summary: Reviews authn/authz, input handling, secrets, data exposure, dependencies and infrastructure security; severity-rated, reproducible findings.

agents.name: performance-engineer
agents.title: Performance Engineer
agents.summary: Establishes baselines, finds bottlenecks with repeatable benchmarks and verifies optimisations keep correctness.

agents.name: ux-reviewer
agents.title: UX Reviewer
agents.summary: Uses the change like a visitor: flows, loading/empty/error states, copy, accessibility and mobile behaviour.

agents.name: ui-reviewer
agents.title: UI Reviewer
agents.summary: Checks visual consistency with the app's design system: colour, type, spacing, alignment, overflow and contrast at desktop and phone widths.

agents.name: docs-engineer
agents.title: Documentation Engineer
agents.summary: Writes and maintains READMEs, architecture docs, API references, runbooks, ADRs and release notes that match the code.

agents.name: approver
agents.title: Approver
agents.summary: Final gate: APPROVE to merge locally, or ESCALATE money, access, deploy/CI, migrations, prod data, new dependencies and product decisions to a human.
